title: 周末去超市
topicEn: Going to the supermarket on weekend

explanations.1: Connects '我' and '妈妈' as a pair.
explanations.2: Indicates doing something together with someone.
explanations.4: Specifies the number of minutes needed to walk.
explanations.6: Interrogative pronoun asking for choice of fruit.
explanations.8: Number indicating one bunch of bananas.
explanations.9: Measure word for Chinese currency unit (yuan).
explanations.11: Subject pronoun for 'we' going to pay.
explanations.13: Possessive/attributive particle linking '回家' and '路上'.
explanations.15: Indicates continuation or addition ('still want to go together').

translation: Today is Saturday. I go to the supermarket together with my mom. The supermarket is behind our home. It only takes ten minutes to walk. We bought a lot of things: fruit, vegetables, and milk. Mom asked me: 'What fruit do you want to eat?' I said: 'I want to eat apples and bananas.' We bought three apples and one bunch of bananas. Then we went to buy milk. One bottle of milk is ten yuan. Mom also bought bread and eggs. Finally, we went to pay. Altogether we spent fifty yuan. On the way home, we were really happy. Next weekend, we still want to go together.
